tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch5:5.3

Suppose $M$ is an embedded Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian submanifold of $\mathbb R^{r,s}$. A smooth curve $\gamma :I\to M$ is a geodesic for $\nabla ^\top $ if and only if $\gamma ''(t)$ is $\overline g^{(r,s)}$-orthogonal to $T_{\gamma (t)}M$ for every $t\in I$.
